German manufacturer explicitly launches the Journey Together ETB with its full-art Ns Zorua promo on 28 March 2025. Printed identifier SVP189 is corroborated independently.

The German original-release date is independently corroborated as 28 March 2025. Later single-shop stock availability is not substituted for the first release. The German product explicitly contains regular and oversized SVP193.

German manufacturer places the specific Zacian-ex tin in Q2 2025. Three native German sealed-product records independently corroborate 16 May 2025 for the exact SVP198 promo, so day precision is accepted without relying on the English release.

The German manufacturer identifies the full-art Mega-Lucario-ex poster promo in Q1 2026. Two native German sealed-product records explicitly date it to 20 March 2026 and match the exact pictured MEP033 card.
The manufacturer dates First Partner Illustration Collection Series 3 to 7 August 2026. Its exact Fennekin promo is MEP059. This supersedes the unrelated 2025 beginning of the MEP promo series.

Two independent native German product listings explicitly date Series 3 to 7 August 2026; the regional Fynx scan prints MEP059. The English manufacturer corroborates the same product/date but is not the sole German-language evidence.

German manufacturer identifies the full-art Fynx ETB promo in Q2 2026; the native sealed-box product date is 22 May 2026. The exact scan is Fynx MEP080, not Fennexis; a secondary article name error is not propagated.

The native German Deluxe Pin collection explicitly releases Zacian LV.X on 8 October 2021; the manufacturers 2021 product index corroborates the product. This is separate from the 2019 promo-series reference.
